properties.site-address: The Engine Sheds, Billendean Road, Tweedmouth
properties.notes: Site of former railway land and engine shed at Tweedmouth. The buildings are still standing but are vacant and unused. Opportunity for redevelopment of former railway land adjacent to ECML. The location lends itself to a proposal of a relatively high density given the urban setting.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
